verdict.rationale: E2B's core purpose is running AI-generated code in secure, isolated cloud sandboxes. The docs describe isolated Firecracker microVMs where agent tools run inside the sandbox instead of on your machine or server. Outbound network access can be switched off or limited with allow/deny lists, so test runs stay separate from production systems, and sandboxes can be created, snapshotted, paused or killed on demand. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the isolation keeps production data untouched.
